home.heroTitle: The home of São Paulo speedcubing
home.heroSubtitle: Competitions, state rankings and a community that grows with every solve. CubingSP connects competitors and enthusiasts across the state.
home.noCompetitions: No competitions announced right now. Check back soon!
home.institutionalText: CubingSP is an independent association representing speedcubing competitors and enthusiasts in the state of São Paulo, Brazil. We support official championships, build tools for delegates and organizers, and help the community grow.

about.title: About CubingSP
about.intro: CubingSP was born from the union of competitors and organizers across the state of São Paulo with one goal: strengthening speedcubing in the state.
about.historyText: São Paulo hosts one of the most active speedcubing communities in Brazil, with official WCA championships held regularly across the state. CubingSP exists to give this community structure: centralizing information, supporting organizers and representing competitors.
about.mission1: Grow the number of official competitions in the state of São Paulo.
about.mission2: Maintain state rankings and give visibility to local competitors.
about.mission3: Build open tools for delegates and organizers.
about.mission4: Bring new cubers into the competitive community.
